metadata.title: Lamborghini Global Market Intelligence & Model Roadmap (2025-2027)

macro_market_dynamics.order_book_backlog: Sant'Agata Bolognese factory is sold out through mid-2026 across entire Revuelto and Urus SE allocations.
macro_market_dynamics.temerario_introduction: Revealed in late 2024 to succeed the Huracán. Features a bespoke 4.0L twin-turbo flat-plane crank V8 revving to 10,000 RPM + 3 axial-flux electric motors producing 920 metric hp. First customer deliveries commence in 2025/2026.
macro_market_dynamics.naturally_aspirated_v10_valuation_surge: Discontinuation of the naturally aspirated 5.2L V10 has triggered immediate secondary market appreciation for Huracán STO, Tecnica, and Sterrato models.
macro_market_dynamics.gated_manual_supercar_bubble: First-generation Gallardo 6-speed gated manual and Murciélago gated cars are trading at 120-180% premiums over their automated counterparts.
macro_market_dynamics.electric_future_roadmap: Lanzador 2+2 Ultra GT concept confirmed for 2028 as Lamborghini's 4th model, featuring 1 Megawatt (1,341 hp) dual-motor all-electric powertrain.
